name: Getac K120-EX G3
summary: The Getac K120-EX G3 is the hazardous-area version of a Getac rugged 12.5-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under IECEx. Getac also states ATEX certification, but the certificate isn't published. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 Pro.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2025-12-09), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX not published; UKEX not found

iecex.marking: Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic op is IIIC T130°C Dc

certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Protect from excessive UV light and mechanical impact (reduced-height impact test). Connection interfaces never used in hazardous areas. Battery never changed, charged or removed in hazardous areas. Not next to strong charge-generating processes. Use only Li-ion battery BP3S1P2100S-01.
safety.peripherals: All connection interfaces (USB, Thunderbolt, DC-in, docking connector, LAN, serial) must never be used in hazardous areas (certificate condition). Optional internal modules named in the certificate are covered as part of the certified tablet. LAN (RJ45), two Thunderbolt 4 and serial port are barred from hazardous areas.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the certificate: hand strap, shoulder strap, shoulder harness strap, digitizer pen and tether. Anti-static screen protection film made for hazardous use. No Ex-listed keyboard: the standard K120 has a keyboard but none is listed for the Ex model. NOT for hazardous areas: AC adapters, USB-C adapter, chargers, spare batteries and the spare SSD kit (non-hazardous areas only).

os.name: Windows
os.updates: Windows 11: supported while kept on a current version (Microsoft Modern Lifecycle)

specs.chip: Intel Core i5-1335U / i5-1345U vPro / i7-1355U / i7-1365U vPro (13th gen)
specs.frontCamera: 5 MP webcam or Windows Hello camera
specs.ports: 2 x Thunderbolt 4, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A, RJ45, DC-in (optional), audio; optional serial, barcode, HF RFID, smart card; micro-SIM optional
specs.docking: Getac DS100 (G2-R datasheet lists it; not on the G3 datasheet)
specs.keyboard: Standard K120 is a convertible with keyboard; no keyboard in Ex datasheet

capabilities.label: NFC reading
capabilities.value: Built in (via optional HF RFID reader)

unconfirmed.certification.iecex.number: Getac's certificate names the model with a 'c' suffix and doesn't name the generation. We matched it to this generation by its batteries, dust group and ambient range.
unconfirmed.safety.certifiedAccessories: Not checked against the certificate for this exact model.
unconfirmed.os.edition: The maker doesn't state the edition year.

limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
